verdict.rationale: Aider is a coding agent, so acting as an MCP client is a fair question for this kind of product, but nothing in the evidence pack mentions MCP or plugging in external tool servers. The closest items are /web scraping, /run, and /test, which are built-in commands rather than pluggable MCP tools, so they earn no credit here.
